target_customer: Consumer hybrid athletes (HYROX, running plus lifting, triathlon) who pay for a training app
problem: Athletes follow static PDF plans or apps focused on only cardio or strength, which cannot adapt around cross-training, travel and fatigue.
business_model: Consumer subscription (free tier, paid premium plans, 7 day trial)
product_category: AI coaching and training app for athletes

founders.name: Ben Katz
founders.background_notes: Led growth at WHOOP, VP of fitness portfolio at Appex (YC page).

founders.name: Matt Ruiters
founders.background_notes: Senior software engineer at AWS (YC page).

founders.name: Caroline Shoemaker
founders.background_notes: First analytics hire at WHOOP, VP productivity portfolio at Appex (YC page).

founders.name: Mats Terwiesch
education: Published health and AI research at Harvard (degree not stated)
founders.background_notes: Led core product at WHOOP; US national rowing team.

technical_complexity.rationale: Wearable data aggregation across Garmin, Whoop, Oura and Apple, plus adaptive plan generation; standard mobile and data engineering with some hard integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Coach partnerships and community help, but plan generation and wearable integrations are easy for Strava, Runna and others to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Many HYROX and hybrid apps appeared by 2025 and 2026; no acquisition of HYBRD found.

market_need_then: Founders say existing products cover only cardio or strength and athletes rely on static plans. HYROX participation was growing (founder and company statements; not independently measured here).

branding.domain_note: hybrd.com, vowel dropped from hybrid; purchase story not found

identity.mascot_or_character: AI coach called Brain (product feature, not a mascot)

branding.brand_signature: Free weekly workout clubs in Boston and San Francisco
branding.community_and_virality: Invitation-only beta and word of mouth positioning, free weekly workout clubs; described as Strava for athletes combining strength and cardio (Fitt Insider).

brand_strength.rationale: Community clubs and athlete founders give authentic positioning, but the vowel-less spelling is unremarkable and traction is unverified.

outcome_analysis: HYBRD is active and early. It launched on iOS in May 2025 after a six month invitation-only beta, built by ex-WHOOP and AWS staff who are themselves hybrid athletes. No funding amounts, shutdown or acquisition were found, so outcome is unresolved and the crowded HYROX app market is the main open risk.
notes: No funding found beyond YC backing. Aggregators (Crunchbase pre-seed placeholder, Dealroom EV estimate) are unreliable. Competition left empty: searches returned only 2025 and 2026 comparison pages (Runna, Strava, TrainingPeaks, Edge), none dated near the Fall 2024 batch. Founders' degrees not found. The Monday workout detail on the YC description was not independently confirmed.
